video_shader_tier_high_hint: Anime4K HQ. Plus net ; idéal pour l'animation, utilisable aussi en prise de vue réelle (gain plus faible). Nécessite un GPU haut milieu de gamme (NVIDIA RTX 4060 / RTX 3070, AMD RX 6700 XT / RX 7700 XT).

sync_pair_fingerprint_changed_body: This address was pinned to a different certificate before. Continue only if you know the peer reinstalled or reset it — otherwise someone may be intercepting the connection.
interconnect_upload_section_footer: Choose what this device uploads to the connected peer. Independent from the cloud backup switches and off by default. These switches only apply while Enable interconnect is on: turning interconnect off stops every upload here.
remote_delete_audiobook_partial: Book deleted, but its audiobook could not be removed on the paired device
download_detail_task_queued: Queued: waiting for other downloads to free a slot. This task has not been handed to the downloader yet, so there is no live peer or tracker data.
book_import_folder_as_source_hint: Keep scanning this folder for new books
game_import_drop_hint: You can also drag .exe files into the game library
video_setting_secondary_av_delay_hint: Adjust the secondary subtitle offset independently. It follows the primary offset until set here.
video_subtitle_drag_adjust_hint: Drag a subtitle up or down to reposition it
anki_connect_mobile_disabled_key_cleared: AnkiConnect needs an API key on mobile, so clearing it turned the switch back off. Anki now goes through the built-in backend again.
manga_import_batch_hint: This folder holds $n volume files; each is imported as its own book, named after its file.
srt_book_reimport_subtitle_hint: Replacing the subtitle rebuilds the book text from the new cues.
srt_book_reimport_no_cues: No subtitle lines found in that file
srt_book_reimport_body_rebuilt: Book text rebuilt — reopen the book to read it
download_backend_unsupported_note: The built-in engine is not available on this platform. Downloads use external qBittorrent.
aidoku_runtime_unavailable: Aidoku extensions are currently available on macOS only.
aidoku_extension_warning: Aidoku extensions execute third-party WebAssembly code with network access. Only continue with sources you trust.
aidoku_webview_unsupported: This source requires Aidoku WebView APIs that are not supported yet.
aidoku_repository_identity_mismatch: The downloaded package does not match the repository index.
aidoku_repository_hint: Paste an Aidoku repository homepage or index.min.json URL. The community repository is filled in by default.
dict_language_description: Decides which font renders this dictionary's text. Automatic uses the language the dictionary declares.
book_language_description: Decides which font renders this book's text. Automatic uses the language declared in the EPUB.
local_audio_reference_unavailable: Can't reference the original file without all-files access; a copy was imported instead.
update_install_gal_hook_holder: Galgame capture component in use: PID $pid - $path (this is the game you are playing, or its capture host). Close the game, then update again.
game_hook_reason_protocol_mismatch: The capture component does not match this Fushi build. It ships inside Fushi, so there is nothing to install separately. First, fully close the game and launch it again: the game process may still hold the component injected by an earlier session. If it still mismatches, the component files on disk are older than Fushi, because the last Fushi update could not replace them while a game was running. Close every game, then run the Fushi installer again.
video_mining_still_format_hint: Encoding used when the card image is a still screenshot. JPG is much smaller; PNG is lossless but several times larger. Animated covers are unaffected — they follow the animation format setting.
gal_mining_still_format_hint: Same formats as video cards, stored separately. Game window grabs come in as PNG: keeping PNG is lossless but several times larger, while JPG matches how these screenshots were compressed before.
manga_source_cloudflare_blocked: This source is protected by Cloudflare and can't be reached by the built-in reader yet.
manga_global_search_prompt: Type a title to search every enabled manga source at once.
manga_global_search_no_sources: No enabled manga sources. Install and enable an extension first.
anki_connect_addon_install_hint: Downloads AnkiConnect from AnkiWeb and hands it to the running Anki. Anki will ask you to confirm, then advise a restart.
anki_connect_addon_handed: Handed AnkiConnect to Anki. Confirm the prompt in Anki, then restart Anki as it advises.
anki_connect_addon_anki_not_running: No running Anki found. Start Anki desktop first, then try again.
anki_connect_addon_download_failed: Could not download AnkiConnect from AnkiWeb: $error
anki_connect_addon_invalid: AnkiWeb returned something that is not a usable add-on package.
anki_connect_addon_launch_failed: Could not hand the add-on to Anki: $error
settings_content_language_description: Fallback language for content that does not declare one. Per-book, per-video, per-game and per-dictionary settings override this.
dict_user_empty: No entries yet. Add one to build your own dictionary.
dict_user_rebuild_failed: Failed to rebuild the user dictionary
sync_err_peer_unreachable: Can't reach the paired device - it may be offline or not running Fushi.
remote_book_list_failed: Couldn't fetch the remote library from the paired device.
video_torznab_settings_hint: Configure one or more Jackett, Prowlarr, or compatible Torznab endpoints. Secrets are never exported in backups; they may sync to paired devices over Interconnect (can be turned off in Interconnect settings).
video_opensubtitles_settings_hint: API credentials are never exported in backups; they may sync to paired devices over Interconnect (can be turned off in Interconnect settings).
sync_interconnect_service_config_toggle_: Receive external service settings and API keys (Jimaku, TMDB, Torznab, OpenSubtitles, tracking) from the paired host over the encrypted Interconnect channel. Requires TLS.
video_setting_subtitle_backfill_hint: When a scrape finishes, videos that still have no subtitle get one from your configured online sources. Never replaces an existing subtitle.
video_subtitle_no_source_configured: No subtitle found · set up an online subtitle source
anime_download_subs_retrying: Subtitles: not up yet — will retry automatically
video_setting_jimaku_default_language_hi: Defaults to the video's own language (audio track / scraped metadata). Pick one to always prefer that language instead.
onboarding_feature_anki_hint: Connect AnkiConnect or AnkiDroid to create flashcards
onboarding_feature_backup_hint: Back up your data to Google Drive, WebDAV and other backends
onboarding_feature_interconnect_hint: Pair devices on your LAN to share libraries and progress
onboarding_step_anki_body: Open card creation settings to connect AnkiConnect (desktop) or AnkiDroid (Android) and test the connection.
onboarding_step_backup_body: Choose a backup backend and sign in, or export a local backup file.
onboarding_step_interconnect_body: Enable interconnect and pair with other devices on your LAN to share libraries, progress and lookups.
onboarding_finish_body: You can revisit this guide anytime from Settings → System.
onboarding_welcome_body: Set your interface language and theme first — the next steps will walk you through the rest.
onboarding_features_modules_label: Library tabs (unchecked ones are hidden from the navigation bar; change anytime in Settings)
onboarding_feature_video_hint: Watch videos with subtitle lookup and mining
onboarding_feature_games_hint: Launch galgames with text-hook lookup (Windows only)
onboarding_feature_pack_hint: One download sets up Japanese dictionaries plus JA/EN pronunciation audio
onboarding_step_pack_body: The recommended pack bundles Japanese word, pitch-accent and frequency dictionaries plus Japanese/English pronunciation audio databases. Download and import it here; importing replaces local data, so run it on a fresh install. Learning another language? Use the dictionary manager to import your own dictionaries instead.
onboarding_pack_downloading: Downloading… cancel anytime, resumes next time
onboarding_step_extension_body: Install the companion browser extension to look up words on any web page.
onboarding_step_fonts_body: Import custom fonts and choose which of UI, book text and dictionary use them.
module_toggle_hint: Show this library tab in the navigation bar; turn off to hide it
video_setting_youtube_quality_hint: Start streams at the highest tier up to this target; Auto prefers smooth playback (hardware-friendly codec, up to 1080p)
manga_discovery_match_none: No match found in enabled sources.
discovery_source_pick_hint: Pick a source to browse, or type a keyword to search every source
discovery_source_query_required: This source only supports keyword search
video_subtitle_no_provider_hint: Enter a Jimaku API key or enable OpenSubtitles under Settings, Downloads, External resource and subtitle providers.
video_jimaku_scope_hint: Japanese subtitles for anime and Japanese live-action titles. A free API key is required.
video_builtin_apibay_hint: Movies and TV shows. Public index, no account needed.
video_builtin_knaben_hint: Movies and TV shows. Aggregates several public indexers.
video_jimaku_enabled_hint: Off means Jimaku is skipped even when an API key is saved.
discovery_sources_settings_hint: Which built-in sources take part in the Discover page's All sources search. Picking a single source in the source dropdown always works, even when it is off here.
video_builtin_sources_hint: Ship with the app: no account, no API key. Turn one off to keep it out of resource searches.
video_builtin_nyaa_hint: Anime only. Movies and TV shows are covered by the two public indexers below.
video_resource_no_provider_hint: This search had no provider to query. Re-enable a built-in source, or add a Torznab indexer, under Settings, Downloads, External resource and subtitle providers.
video_source_scrape_run_no_issues: No warnings or errors were recorded.
video_source_scrape_manual_search_hint: Search the metadata provider by title, then pick the correct work.
video_import_folder_as_source_hint: Keep scanning this folder for new videos
manga_import_folder_as_source_hint: Keep scanning this folder for new manga
download_no_managed_video_source: No managed video source yet. Downloads need a local video folder to land in.
storage_entry_delete_book_confirm_body: This removes the book, its reading progress and paired audio copies from this device.
storage_entry_delete_dictionary_confirm_: This removes the dictionary and its imported data.
storage_modules_anime4k_hint: Can be downloaded again anytime in video settings
storage_bundled_hint: Shipped with the installer; deleted files come back on the next update, listed for reference only.
